verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser exposes single-call agent tasks (page.ai, extract, scrape) and an MCP tool server, but there is no evidence of a workflow builder supporting loops, conditionals, or parameterized multi-step flows — usage is one-shot prompt/task oriented rather than composable pipelines. missing for 10: any workflow/orchestration API, control-flow constructs (loops/conditionals), parameterization or reusable workflow templates.
